criterion: The announcement bar carries three messages that rotate through one line at the top of every route.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the bar shows one message at a time and the three pinned messages each appear in turn. Answer no when the bar is absent, carries only one message for the whole visit, or shows all three at once.

criterion: The catalogue pages by numbered controls at the foot of the grid.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when numbered page controls sit below the grid and moving to a numbered page changes the products shown. Answer no when the grid appends products on scroll or offers only a load-more control.

criterion: The struck-through original sits beside the sale price on every card.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when each card shows two amounts, the higher one struck through. Answer no when a card shows a single amount or places the struck-through amount on its own line away from the price.

criterion: The star row sits above the price on a card that carries a rating.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the stars and the review count render above the price line. Answer no when the stars render below the price or beside the title.

criterion: The founding year 1985 appears on the heritage banner of the home route.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the heritage banner on the home page shows 1985. Answer no when the banner is absent or shows another year.

criterion: The signup heading reads Get 10% Off Your First Order.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the signup block carries that heading verbatim. Answer no when the heading is reworded or missing.

criterion: The colourway swatches on a product route change the gallery image and the price together.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when selecting a swatch updates both the lead gallery image and the price line. Answer no when either one stays behind.

criterion: The cart drawer opens over the page carrying the lines, the subtotal and the checkout control.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when adding a watch opens a panel over the page holding all three. Answer no when the page navigates away or the panel omits the subtotal or the checkout control.

criterion: A sold-out colourway shows as sold-out and stays selectable on a product route.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the swatch remains in the grid, is selectable, and states the sold-out wording once chosen. Answer no when the swatch is dropped from the grid or cannot be chosen.

criterion: The header cart control carries a count of the units the cart holds.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a numeric badge on the header cart control tracks the summed quantities. Answer no when the badge counts lines or is absent.

criterion: The currency control in the header lists the two display currencies.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the header offers a control listing both display currencies. Answer no when only one currency is reachable.

criterion: The checkout opens as its own route carrying the order summary beside the address form.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the checkout has its own address and shows the summary alongside the form. Answer no when the checkout is a panel over the cart or hides the summary.

criterion: The breadcrumb on a product route names the collection the visitor arrived from.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the breadcrumb above the product title names that collection. Answer no when the breadcrumb is absent or always names the catch-all collection.

criterion: The empty cart route offers a control that returns the visitor to the catalogue.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when an empty cart shows a control leading back to the catalogue. Answer no when the empty cart is a bare line of text.

criterion: The product grid arranges cards of one height in four columns on a wide viewport.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a wide viewport shows four cards a row and the cards in a row end level. Answer no when the column count differs or the cards in a row end at different heights.

criterion: The footer carries four columns ending with the contact column.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the footer holds four headed columns and the last one is the contact column. Answer no when the footer holds another number of columns or ends elsewhere.

criterion: The benefit strip beneath the hero on the home route carries five reassurance devices in one row.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when five benefit blocks sit in one row under the hero. Answer no when the strip is absent or carries another number.

criterion: The announcement messages at the top of the home route advance one after another on a timed loop.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when the bar advances on its own and returns to the first message after the last. Answer no when the bar is static or advances only on a click.

criterion: Every interactive control on the storefront reaches a visible focus ring by keyboard.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when tabbing through a route moves a visible ring onto each control in turn. Answer no when the ring is suppressed or skips reachable controls.

criterion: The product grid reflows to two columns on a phone-width viewport.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a phone-width viewport shows two cards a row. Answer no when the grid keeps four columns, drops to one, or scrolls sideways.

criterion: A card reserves blank space for a star row on a product that lacks a rating.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when an unrated card leaves an empty band where the stars would sit. Answer no when the card below rises to meet the price line.

criterion: The catalogue loads more products as the visitor scrolls in place of numbered paging.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when scrolling to the foot of the grid appends more products. Answer no when the grid ends at the numbered controls.

criterion: A review composer appears on the route of a single watch.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when a product route offers a form for writing a review. Answer no when the ratings are read-only throughout.

criterion: The price on a card disagrees with the price on the same watch's own route.
evaluation_rule: Answer yes when one watch shows two different amounts on the two surfaces in one currency. Answer no when the two agree.
